features.title: Toggle the sidebar with the platform primary chord
features.summary: Capture primary+B in the browser capture phase, prevent competing shell handling, and choose Meta on Mac or Control elsewhere.
failureModes: Modifier mismatch leaves the browser and Host behavior untouched.
A missing layout service is surfaced rather than silently swallowed.

onboarding.firstAction: Press Cmd+B on a Mac or Ctrl+B elsewhere.
onboarding.doneWhen: The sidebar hides and shows again on the next press.

verification.testName: resolves primary to Meta on macOS and Control elsewhere
refuses a chord carrying an extra modifier
claims a matching chord before bubble listeners see it
leaves events alone that someone else already handled or that repeat

telemetry.reason: Client-only: Toggle the sidebar with the platform primary chord renders browser state and starts no Host work of its own.

features.title: Select native panels with keyboard shortcuts
features.summary: Use primary+N and primary+comma to select the declared panel target while respecting editable fields, IME composition, repeat, terminal ownership, and prior event claims. A chord the shell reads inside xterm opts out of the terminal.
failureModes: Extra Alt or Shift modifiers do not trigger a shortcut.

verification.testName: accepts text fields and editable regions, refuses buttons and checkboxes
stops listening once disposed
resolves the terminal before the text field it holds, then editable, then page
leaves the key to the shell when the chord opts out of the terminal
keeps claiming the chord in the terminal when it does not opt out

telemetry.reason: Client-only: Select native panels with keyboard shortcuts renders browser state and starts no Host work of its own.

features.title: Rebindable command keys
features.summary: Binds every dshx Command on the keys it answers to now: its default keys, or the binding the user chose in the Host's Keyboard shortcuts dialog for an editable command. Editable commands are listed there without a default binding, and page-scoped commands keep their keys off inside text fields.
failureModes: A command whose id has no Host shortcut form stays unlisted with a console warning and keeps its default keys.
A binding with modifiers other than Mod and Shift stays unbound with a console warning.

verification.testName: lists only editable commands, unbound, under their Host id, and passes key presses back to the capture listener

telemetry.reason: Client-only: key bindings and the Host shortcut registry live in the browser and start no Host work.

features.title: Single keys, sequences and scoped keys
features.summary: Binds every dshx Command key by scope (global, not-typing, list, triage, changes, composer): chords, single keys (J, Shift+J, ?), ⌥ letters and two-step sequences (G then I within 1.2 s), matched by physical key. A list, triage or changes key fires only inside its region (or the region last used when nothing has focus); single keys and ⌥ letters never fire in a text field, an IME composition or an open menu, and one setting turns character keys off.
features.currentSurface: keyboard: J / K / E / ? / G then I

configuration.constraints: Boolean; false turns every character-key shortcut off (J, E, ?, G then I). Chords with ⌘ or Ctrl and ⌥ letters stay on.

failureModes: An unparsable key spec stays unbound with one console warning naming the command and spec.
An old Host without the dshfiles-shortcuts namespace reads as single keys on, the default.

verification.testName: keeps single keys, Shift keys and ⌥ letters out of text fields, and lets the characters through
never fires a single key during an IME composition
turns every character key off with the setting, and keeps chords and ⌥ letters on
runs a sequence when the second key comes within 1.2 s, and drops it after
fires list keys only inside a list region, and lets the innermost owner win
sends keys from the page to the region last used, else to an ambient one
fires composer chords only from inside the composer, and passes the trigger

telemetry.reason: Client-only: key matching runs in the browser; the Host half only registers the settings namespace.

features.title: Keyboard shortcut sheet
features.summary: ? or ⌘/ opens a sheet of every bound key grouped by where it works (Global, Go to, Lists, Triage, Changes, Composer, App), generated from the dshx Command registry and the Host shortcut catalog, with the Single-key shortcuts switch beside the keys it turns off.

configuration.constraints: Boolean; false turns every character-key shortcut off (J, E, ?, G then I). Chords with ⌘ or Ctrl and ⌥ letters stay on.

failureModes: Without a writable settings namespace the switch shows disabled and keys stay on.

verification.testName: groups bound keys by scope or section, in reading order, and collapses duplicates
drops character keys while single-key shortcuts are off
lists Host chords under App unless a command already names them, and follows user rebindings

telemetry.reason: Client-only: the sheet renders browser registries and starts no Host work.
